text:
zoe (Sales): Putting this thread here — OrionShift wants a 10-day POC. They built a custom variant called 'orca-edge-12b-q8b-lite' and ask: reserved token pricing for ~1M tokens/mo, KV cache behavior (session vs cross-session), Dedicated A100 compatibility, and Private VPC with customer KMS. Looping @dan_ml @kyra_ops @sam_sec.

dan_ml (Eng-ML): Quick clarifying q: was the model exported with operator fusion or custom CUDA kernels? If fused ops exist we need either the unfused checkpoint or the fused op source/binaries + build info. Also what p95 are they targeting?

zoe (Sales): They want p95 <= 320ms for simple completions. Typical prompts ~30 tokens, responses ~160 tokens. They mentioned using export-time optimizations that might have fused attention.

dan_ml (Eng-ML): Fusion could be a runtime compatibility issue. If they can provide an unfused checkpoint we can run on our standard kernel path. If not, we may need a compatibility test or a custom runtime build which can add ~3 business days to setup. For smoke tests I'll try int8/q8b paths with prefix_session KV cache. Example smoke config I'd run on Dedicated:```yaml
model: orca-edge-12b-q8b-lite
precision: q8b
hardware: a100-80gb
batching:
  max_tokens_per_batch: 6144
  latency_target_ms: 300
kv_cache: prefix_session
sequence_max: 2048
```

zoe (Sales): Noted. I'll request unfused checkpoint, training repo commit, and a small validation set (40 prompts). They also asked about hosted equivalent pricing vs reserved.

kyra_ops (Solutions): Ballpark reserved economics for a 12B q8b-like variant on A100: roughly $0.005
 to $0.012 per 1k tokens depending on utilization and cache hit rate. KV hit-rate and batching matter a lot. Once Eng-ML provides perf numbers I can produce a detailed reserved pool + effective per-token quote.

sam_sec (Security): BYO-KMS + Private VPC supported. We'll need their KMS key ARN, key policy, rotation cadence, and a completed security questionnaire. If they plan to process regulated data mark that in the questionnaire (PHI triggers compliance). Also confirm if they require logs forwarded to their SIEM and whether they need dedicated audit retention.

dan_ml (Eng-ML): For perf validation I need: model artifact (wheel or checkpoint), 40 prompts, and a concurrency profile (burst shape and peak concurrent sessions). If the export included fused attention ask for the export command + CUDA/cuDNN versions used. I'll run perf and a small quality regression against our baseline to spot any numeric regressions from quantization/fusion.

infra-bot: Ticket POC-8444 created: "orionshift-poc-staging" assigned to eng-ml and eng-infra. ETA: 48h. :package:

kyra_ops (Solutions): Cost sensitivity note: if session prefix reuse is high (>=60%) effective per-token cost can drop ~20-30% vs low reuse. Ask them for expected reuse patterns.

zoe (Sales): They're saying ~65% prefix reuse within sessions. I'll push the artifact/answers now and ask them to mark the security questionnaire high priority.

dan_ml (Eng-ML): Good. If they cannot provide unfused artifacts, I'll still run a compatibility smoke but expect possible kernel fallbacks and a slower perf profile. I'll report back with any required runtime changes.

kyra_ops (Solutions): After Dan's perf + compatibility report I'll draft a reserved quote (pool size, monthly commit, effective per-token) within 48h.

sam_sec (Security): If they want faster security turnaround provide SOC2 evidence and prioritize the questionnaire; normal review 2-3 business days.

zoe (Sales): Thanks all. I'll post updates as soon as they upload artifacts. :rocket:
